---
title: "Figure 4: S7 evidence-directness profile"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 4: Evidence directness across RQ1-RQ4
#
# Input:
#   output/tables/Chapter4_Analysis_Tables.xlsx
#   sheet: 16_Figure4_RQ_Directness
# Output:
#   output/figures/Figure_4_S7_Evidence_Directness_Heatmap.png
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "here", "readxl", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "scales", "grid"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the required packages before rendering this file: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Relative input and output paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

source_file <- here(
  "output",
  "tables",
  "Chapter4_Analysis_Tables.xlsx"
)

figure_dir <- here("output", "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(source_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Input file not found: ", source_file,
      "\nRun 01_chapter4_analysis.qmd before generating Figure 4."
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read and validate the final Figure 4 data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

figure4_raw <- read_excel(
  path = source_file,
  sheet = "16_Figure4_RQ_Directness"
)

required_columns <- c(
  "RQ", "Evidence_Directness", "Studies",
  "RQ_Total", "Share_of_RQ"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(figure4_raw))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Required Figure 4 columns are missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

rq_levels <- c("RQ1", "RQ2", "RQ3", "RQ4")

directness_levels <- c(
  "Direct Data Paper / Data Journal",
  "Adjacent research-data",
  "Infrastructure / mechanism"
)

figure4_summary <- figure4_raw |>
  transmute(
    RQ = as.character(RQ),
    Evidence_Directness = as.character(Evidence_Directness),
    n = as.numeric(Studies),
    Total = as.numeric(RQ_Total),
    Percentage = as.numeric(Share_of_RQ)
  ) |>
  filter(RQ %in% rq_levels)

expected_grid <- expand.grid(
  RQ = rq_levels,
  Evidence_Directness = directness_levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  as_tibble()

if (
  nrow(anti_join(expected_grid, figure4_summary, by = c("RQ", "Evidence_Directness"))) > 0 ||
    nrow(anti_join(figure4_summary, expected_grid, by = c("RQ", "Evidence_Directness"))) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Figure 4 does not contain exactly one row for every required ",
    "RQ-by-directness combination."
  )
}

if (any(!figure4_summary$Evidence_Directness %in% directness_levels)) {
  stop("Figure 4 contains an unrecognized evidence-directness category.")
}

if (
  n_distinct(
    figure4_summary$RQ,
    figure4_summary$Evidence_Directness
  ) != nrow(expected_grid)
) {
  stop("Figure 4 contains duplicate RQ-by-directness rows.")
}

rq_validation <- figure4_summary |>
  group_by(RQ) |>
  summarise(
    Categories = n(),
    Calculated_Total = sum(n),
    Reported_Total = first(Total),
    Percentage_sum = sum(Percentage),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Total_Check = Calculated_Total == Reported_Total,
    Percentage_Check = abs(Percentage_sum - 100) <= 0.01
  )

if (
  any(!rq_validation$Total_Check) ||
    any(!rq_validation$Percentage_Check) ||
    any(rq_validation$Categories != length(directness_levels))
) {
  print(rq_validation)
  stop("Figure 4 validation failed.")
}

figure4_summary <- figure4_summary |>
  mutate(
    RQ = factor(RQ, levels = rq_levels),
    Evidence_Directness = factor(
      Evidence_Directness,
      levels = directness_levels
    ),
    Label = sprintf("%d\n(%.1f%%)", n, Percentage)
  ) |>
  arrange(RQ, Evidence_Directness)

fill_max <- max(
  10,
  ceiling(max(figure4_summary$Percentage, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
)

print(
  figure4_summary |>
    select(
      RQ,
      Evidence_Directness,
      n,
      Total,
      Percentage
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Draw and export the heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rq_display_order <- c("RQ4", "RQ3", "RQ2", "RQ1")

# Use a generic font family so the figure renders consistently across
# macOS, Windows and Linux without requiring a separately registered font.
plot_font <- "sans"

figure4_heatmap <- ggplot(
  figure4_summary,
  aes(
    x = Evidence_Directness,
    y = RQ,
    fill = Percentage
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = Label,
      colour = Percentage >= 36
    ),
    family = plot_font,
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rq_display_order,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Direct Data Paper /\nData Journal",
      "Adjacent research-data",
      "Infrastructure /\nmechanism"
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "white",
      "FALSE" = "#0B2742"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#F5F9FC",
      "#D1E3F0",
      "#ABCDE4",
      "#316996",
      "#204F7A"
    ),
    limits = c(0, fill_max),
    breaks = seq(0, fill_max, 10),
    name = "Share of each RQ evidence pool (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Evidence category",
    y = "Research question"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11,
    base_family = plot_font
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = plot_font,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10.5,
      colour = "black",
      lineheight = 0.9
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(t = 7)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black",
      margin = margin(r = 7)
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 9,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 0.9
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8.5,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 3,
      r = 8,
      b = 6,
      l = 6
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colourbar(
      title.position = "right",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      barwidth = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(10, "cm"),
      ticks = TRUE,
      frame.colour = "grey40"
    )
  )

print(figure4_heatmap)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "Figure_4_S7_Evidence_Directness_Heatmap.png"
  ),
  plot = figure4_heatmap,
  width = 9.2,
  height = 4.67,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Figure 4 saved to: ", figure_dir)
```
